cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Lend Me the Edge
cards.instruction: Get someone to provide the one advantage you need without making the eventual success feel borrowed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me the oven temperature you used for your prize cake. Just the number; I'll handle the baking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That number took me six attempts to find.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it's properly tested. Please separate the setting from the recipe; I'm not asking you to make my cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll tell you if the entry says 'temperature supplied by Jo'.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put that under equipment settings, not beside my name. And use degrees, please; 'Jo's secret' isn't a temperature I can put on the dial.
